evidence_rule: an access counts only when its value (or a copy or cast of it) is a load/store address (after at most a constant offset or scaled index), an indirect-call target, an argument a type-locked pointer parameter takes, or the return of a function declared to return a pointer; a type merged into the value (phi, merged local) is not evidence. A value divided, taken a remainder of, shifted, multiplied (not by -1), compared with sign, sign-extended or converted to float keeps the field its type and blocks the compare-partner rule. A first-access pointer whose pointee outranks the proven one is kept.

castbench.method: castbench full (45 binaries x O0/O2/O2-noinline), one build, --option fieldtype on vs the default off; the default arm is byte-identical to a fresh origin/main aaf21509b arm on all 45 binaries
castbench.more_read: all 14 shared: sort -O0 mergelines_node +20 (lo/hi proven only as pointers to undefined 8-byte words; the locals they are read into stay long and each read pays a cast), diff -O2 read_files +3 (buffer fields now void * / char *, indexed by variables), gnulib hash transfer_entries x10 +1 each (the entry's next pointer is now long *, the bucket it is stored into is still a record kuna reads as long[]), tar -O0 append_incremental_renames +1 (a pointer field assigned a callee's integer return), diff -O0 0x124fe +1 (a char * field read into an unsigned char * local); outside the shared set tar's gnulib regex (+2..+9 each) indexes fields proven only void * by computed byte offsets
